publicationRule: No Insight may imply practitioner, clinical, psychosocial or WHS expertise through an editorial byline. Named expert review is displayed only after the reviewer and review are confirmed.

statusDefinitions.source-reviewed: Material claims and scope boundaries are supported by named primary sources; operational or practitioner approval may still be required.
statusDefinitions.editorial-review-required: The replacement copy remains an implementation candidate until the named subject-matter review gate is completed.
statusDefinitions.expert-reviewed: A named expert has substantively reviewed the copy and approved the displayed attribution.
